description_en: Modifies the status of a data masking rule
description_zh: 调用DsgDesensPlanUpdateStatus接口，修改脱敏规则的生效状态
name: DsgDesensPlanUpdateStatus

parameters.help_en: A collection of IDs of the data masking rules of which the status you want to modify
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改状态的脱敏规则ID集合
parameters.name: ids

parameters.help_en:
The code of the level-1 data masking scenario to which the rule belongs. Valid values:

dataworks_display_desense_code: masking of displayed data in DataStudio and Data Map
maxcompute_desense_code: data masking at the MaxCompute compute engine layer
maxcompute_new_desense_code: data masking at the MaxCompute compute engine layer (new)
hologres_display_desense_code: data masking at the Hologres compute engine layer
dataworks_data_integration_desense_code: static data masking in Data Integration
dataworks_analysis_desense_code: masking of displayed data in DataAnalysis
parameters.help_zh:
脱敏规则所属的一级脱敏场景Code。取值如下：
数据开发/数据地图展示脱敏：dataworks_display_desense_code
MaxCompute引擎层脱敏：maxcompute_desense_code
MaxCompute引擎层脱敏（新）：maxcompute_new_desense_code
Hologres引擎层脱敏：hologres_display_desense_code
数据集成静态脱敏：dataworks_data_integration_desense_code
数据分析展示脱敏：dataworks_analysis_desense_code
parameters.name: scene_code

parameters.help_en:
The status of the data masking rule. Valid values:

0: expired
1: effective
parameters.help_zh:
脱敏规则的生效状态。取值如下：
0：失效。
1：生效
parameters.name: status

Data.description_en:
The operation result. Valid values:

true: The operation is successful.
false: The operation fails
Data.description_zh:
操作结果。取值如下：
true：操作成功。
false：操作失败

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can locate logs and troubleshoot issues based on the ID
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
